_about: Public-domain William Thomas Herridge (1857-1929), minister of St Andrew's Presbyterian Church, Ottawa, and moderator of the Presbyterian Church in Canada, for the Word Hoard: Christianity in its Relation to the State and the Church, The Orbit of Life, The Coign of Vantage, and his St Andrew's sermons (1889-1917). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 100 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
